action_summary: An absolute path outside the repository was silently rewritten into one inside it. goal_compiler._repo_paths matches a path with a pattern that cannot start at '/', so it reattaches the leading separator -- an arm added for absolute paths INSIDE the tree -- and had no arm for absolute paths outside it: those fell through and were joined onto the root, so "/tmp/ws/calc.py" became the repository spelling "tmp/ws/calc.py" bound to the phantom "<repo>/tmp/ws/calc.py". Measured on main c34c150: "Format /tmp/ws_probe5/calc.py." formatted the caller's file and then reported FAIL_CLOSED__STATED_SWE_EFFECT_UNSERVED, because the declared output was the phantom the adapter could not find (CLI_EXPECTED_OUTPUT_MISSING). The alias is a wrong-file hazard as well: had <repo>/tmp/ws/calc.py existed, the sentence about /tmp would have edited THAT file and reported success. The token is now not bound at all when it lies outside the root, and the door names the scope (FAIL_CLOSED__STATED_PATH_OUTSIDE_THE_WORKSPACE:<path>) instead of blaming a missing capability. Measured after: same sentence refuses by name and leaves the bytes untouched; absolute and relative paths inside the tree are unchanged; census 28/28 twice and the in-repository SWE matrix 6/6.
